snippet.title: CARTAGRA FHD Opening Movie
snippet.description:
The visual novel masterpiece by Innocent Grey, the renowned creators of Kara no Shojo, Cartagra, is now available in remastered HD, including the epilogue "Sacrament"!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4290390/CARTAGRA
Releases June 25th, 2026, Wishlist now!
